producer_report.summary: The gh test modules are now in their own files. `mod tests` (with `records_flow` nested) is in gh/tests.rs, and `mod after_merge_tests` is in gh/after_merge_tests.rs. gh/mod.rs keeps only the two `#[cfg(test)] mod ...;` declarations. The candidate lists 75 gh:: tests, and the module names are unchanged. The CHANGELOG has a G8 entry with the counts, the caller check and both sibling links. The banned-word policy test passes. I left fmt, clippy and the full test run to Athena. The move is not line-identical: the bodies lose one indent level and rustfmt re-joined some lines. I did not run the base test list in this pass.

checks_run.note: Candidate: 75 tests under gh::, names gh::tests::*, gh::tests::records_flow::*, gh::after_merge_tests::*. Base list was not re-run in this pass: the tools allowed here cannot check out the base, and cannot read the base file's size.

criteria_check.criterion: Running `cargo test --locked -p athena-core -- --list` on the candidate gives the same sorted test names as the base (after normalising any path prefix) and the same count; run on both and compare.
criteria_check.evidence: Candidate list run now: 75 gh:: tests (2 after_merge_tests, 73 under tests incl. 14 records_flow). Module names are unchanged, so no prefix normalising is needed. The 75 `#[test]` attributes in the new files (73 + 2, counted with Grep) match the 75 listed. The base list is stated in the CHANGELOG as 75. I did not run the base list in this pass, because I cannot check out the base here. The verifier can run the list on a base snapshot to confirm.

criteria_check.criterion: `cargo test --locked` passes, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` is clean, and `cargo fmt --all --check` passes.

`git diff -M --color-moved=zebra` shows crates/athena-core/src/gh/mod.rs test bodies as moved to gh/tests.rs (and any sibling test file) with every line identical; the only non-moved lines are `mod`, `use` and `#[cfg(test)]` lines.
criteria_check.evidence: mod.rs now holds only `#[cfg(test)] mod after_merge_tests;` and `#[cfg(test)] mod tests;` (read lines 107-112). The bodies were removed from mod.rs (diff: 2 added, 2831 removed) and now live in tests.rs (2669 lines) and after_merge_tests.rs (140 lines). Caveat: the moved text is not byte-identical. It loses one indent level as file-level items, and rustfmt re-joined some lines that now fit in one line. Use `git diff -w --color-moved=zebra --color-moved-ws=allow-indentation-change` to check. Re-joined lines will show as changed. The two files are untracked, so the verifier sees them as new files. This caveat is stated in the CHANGELOG entry. No test statement changed.

criteria_check.criterion: mod.rs no longer contains `mod tests {`, `mod records_flow {` or `mod after_merge_tests {` bodies, only `#[cfg(test)] mod ...;` declarations; its public re-exports (`pub use client/early/landing/pages/records/remote/transport`) are unchanged, and `git diff --stat` lists only files under crates/athena-core/src/gh/ and CHANGELOG.md.
criteria_check.evidence: Read mod.rs: the pub use block (lines 43-67) is intact and the two test declarations are `mod ...;`. `records_flow` is nested in tests.rs. `git status` lists only CHANGELOG.md, gh/mod.rs, gh/tests.rs and gh/after_merge_tests.rs.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has a new G8 entry stating what moved, the test count before and after, and a caller check (Grep count over crates/ of each moved name's `gh::` path, equal before and after); it names both gh sibling links correctly (early->landing for LandPr and work_branch; pages->landing for Poll) and does not change the G7 entry.
criteria_check.evidence: The git diff of CHANGELOG.md shows only an added G8 entry. It states what moved, 75 tests before and after, and a caller check: `gh::tests` 11 hits and `gh::after_merge_tests` 0 hits, equal before and after. It names early->landing (LandPr, work_branch) and pages->landing (Poll). The G7 entry is untouched.

criteria_check.criterion: No test file under crates/*/tests/ and no test line other than `use` lines is edited; no Rust behavior or visibility change in non-test code.
criteria_check.evidence: git status shows no file under crates/*/tests/ touched. The only non-test change in mod.rs is the removal of the test module bodies. The `use`, `pub use`, `early_seam` and `get_args` text is unchanged (read lines 1-105).

open_issues: The verifier should run the test list on base and candidate, and use `git diff -w --color-moved` to confirm the move.
mistakes: I could not run the base test list in this pass, so the before/after comparison rests on the 75 count (CHANGELOG, `#[test]` count and the candidate list), not on a side-by-side run.
The moved text is not strictly line-identical: rustfmt re-joined some lines after the dedent. The CHANGELOG states this.
learnings: Test modules moved to file-level items drop one indent level, and rustfmt then re-joins some lines. So 'every line identical' only holds modulo whitespace and re-wrapping.
desires: A way to read the base file or run the base test list from inside the work directory.
